links.outcome: Understandability and actionability of ChatGPT breast screening information sheets (PEMAT-P, CDC Index)
links.effect: GPT3.5 PEMAT-P understandability 68.0%, actionability 36.7%, CDC Index 58.8%; GPT4 understandability 75.0%, actionability 53.3%, CDC Index 66.0%. Both poor and unclear.
links.quote: Both ChatGPT versions exhibited poor understandability and actionability and were unclear in their messaging.

links.outcome: Accuracy and completeness of ChatGPT breast screening content versus BreastScreen NSW gold standard
links.effect: GPT3.5 lacked accuracy, omitting key insights; GPT4 was superior but still included several key omissions.
links.quote: GPT4 was deemed superior to GPT3.5 but included several key omissions: PEMAT-P understandability 75.0% (SD = 17) and actionability 53.3% (SD = 11.54); CDC Index 66.0% (SD = 4.1).

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, understandability, and actionability of patient education materials generated by ChatGPT-3.5 and GPT-4 for screening mammography without testing an organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
